page.overview:
Who is Abe (Lincoln Impersonator)?

Abe officiated the wedding of Jamie Madrox and Layla Miller. Shortly after the ceremony, he was attacked in the chapel's parking lot and decapitated with a sword by the undead General Robert E. Lee.

Lee had returned from the dead after repeated American Civil War reenactments and sought to punish those who trivialized the conflict and the suffering of those who died in it.

He targeted Abe and other Civil War impersonators because he regarded their portrayals as a mockery of the war and its casualties.
